title: "07 - Linear models"
format:

    toc-expand: 4

Learning objectives for this week:

- Implement and interpret linear regression models.
- Evaluate and interpret loss functions in regression analyses such as Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Mean Squared Error (MSE)  and R² (Coefficient of Determination).
- Implement and interpret logistic regression models.
- Evaluate and interpret precision, recall, and F1 score in binary classification tasks.
